acceptance: BaseFormatConverter and ParquetConverter stream delimited inputs in bounded batches (no full-table csv.read_csv/pa.concat_tables materialization) and count rows inline during conversion without a second decompression pass.

Bidirectional DuckDB EXCEPT ALL returns 0 rows comparing legacy converter vs streaming converter Parquet output for TPC-H SF 0.01, 0.1, and 1.0 plus at least one headered CSV benchmark (e.g., tsbs_devops), with identical logical Arrow/Parquet schemas.
Downstream Delta, Iceberg, Vortex, and DuckLake converter tests pass with zero regressions.
Measured peak RSS at SF 1 and SF 10 under make heavy-run shows bounded memory materially below the datagen-p0-baseline-measurements baseline and within the ADR budget.
context:
Phase 1 step 2 of the faster data-generation plan. Implements adr-python-core-runtime.md's first remedy across every backend and keeps BenchBox's streaming Parquet converter viable as the published-run default during parallel buildout.

2026-11-24 update (from Phase 0 & adversarial review findings #5, #8, D1):
- Root cause of single-row-group Parquet files found: ConversionOptions.row_group_size in benchbox/utils/format_converters/base.py defaults to 128*1024*1024 (134M rows, confusing bytes with rows).
- Streaming conversion must fix row_group_size to 122,880 rows (tracked in data_generation_hash) and explicitly obtain owner sign-off for the resulting Parquet-scan re-baseline (2x2 isolation on TPC-H SF 0.1 lineitem showed 12.94ms -> 5.14ms from row-group count alone on identical BenchBox types).
- Must also fix the 4 failing FormatConversionOrchestrator benchmarks discovered in Phase 0: tsbs_devops (schema columns shape), vector_search (CSV header row), coffeeshop (csv_delimiter=',' ignored), and joinorder_synthetic (non-dict column schema).
- Wall-time budget: <= 6s SF 1 / <= 60s SF 10 for currently-passing benchmarks and <= 10s SF 1 / <= 100s SF 10 for the 4 repaired benchmarks; peak RSS <= 512 MiB SF 1 / <= 1,024 MiB SF 10 (N=3 medians).

2026-11-24 owner decision (Option 1): Explicitly approved adopting 122,880 rows/row-group as the default Parquet layout across all runs and re-baselining the Parquet corpus (with data_generation_hash separating pre- and post-change runs).

2026-11-24 update (Issue #6 resolved): Created dedicated `datagen-p1-parquet-corpus-rebaseline` item (depends on this item and `bundle-data-generation-hash-missing-from-corpus`, Option A: re-run local Parquet suites while leaving the 9 cloud bundles marked pre-re-baseline). In this converter PR: (1) record owner Option 1 sign-off in `docs/internal/adr/adr-benchbox-datagen.md`, (2) stamp `parquet_writer='benchbox-streaming'`, `parquet_row_group_size`, and `data_generation_identity_hash` in `FormatConversionOrchestrator`, and (3) mark cached pre-streaming Parquet manifests lacking `parquet_writer`/`parquet_row_group_size` as stale when Parquet is requested so local `datagen/` caches regenerate cleanly.
description:
## Problem
benchbox/utils/format_converters/base.py currently reads entire delimited tables into memory (pyarrow.csv.read_csv + pa.concat_tables) to write Parquet and then re-opens/decompresses source text files line by line to validate row counts. This causes unnecessary peak RSS spikes and triple I/O for every generator backend.

## Change
- Replace full-table materialization in BaseFormatConverter and ParquetConverter (benchbox/utils/format_converters/base.py, parquet_converter.py) with streaming batch conversion (pyarrow.csv.open_csv -> pyarrow.parquet.ParquetWriter, or equivalent streaming Arrow/DuckDB COPY pipeline).
- Count rows inline during the streaming conversion pass rather than re-reading source delimited files for validate_row_count.
- Preserve existing logical Arrow/Parquet schemas, null/empty-string semantics, compression options, partitioning, and metadata.

## Decision gates
- If streaming batch conversion changes Parquet physical row-group layout materially enough to shift Parquet-scan query timings on DuckDB/DataFusion/Polars, record the timing delta in the PR and ensure row-group size matches the ADR specification before merging.
- Stop and report if any downstream table-format converter (Delta, Iceberg, Vortex, DuckLake) relies on full-table in-memory batches in a way that requires explicit refactoring.

## Guardrails
- Preserve existing Parquet logical types (DECIMAL, DATE32, INT32/INT64, UTF8, nullability) and existing converter default behavior for published runs.
- Verify with bidirectional DuckDB EXCEPT ALL (never plain EXCEPT).
- Follow AGENTS.md ([COMMENT-POLICY-001], [HEAVY-LOCK-001] for SF 1/SF 10 measurements, linked worktree, make pr-preflight, merged PR closeout).
